issue.body:
The reason why I ask is because request.headers is another convenient place to pass along string data between layers of middleware. E.g.:

* debug strings.

* auth tokens.

You may say, then why not stick them on response.headers? 

I could, But these strings can be considered semi-sensitive and I may not want them to leak back to client (which means I have to delete them in my final request handlers).
issue.title: Why request headers is an immutable Mapping but response headers are mutable?
